chose: detail view labels metadata with the schema's own field names — agent/session/job/branch/commit
over: copying the mockup's 'stream:' label for the first segment
because: decisions.ts says the first segment IS r.agent (WHO); 'stream' is this file's word for a session, so using it for the agent field would teach the wrong mapping

chose: one colon column per RECORD: the widest label present (metadata + body together) sets the value column
over: a fixed global column sized to 'discriminated by' for every kind
separate columns for the metadata block and the body
because: a decision's widest label is 'supersedes', a conjecture's is 'discriminated by' — sizing per record keeps a plain decision tight while still giving every entry one flush value column, which is the whole legibility win

chose: absent metadata fields (branch, commit) are omitted; commit carries dirty as ' (dirty)' suffix
over: printing '-' and 'no-commit' placeholders as the old ·-joined line did
because: the task's rule — omit rather than print empty labels — and a labeled block makes absence legible on its own: a missing 'commit:' row reads as 'no commit', no placeholder needed

chose: blank lines separate BODY fields only; the metadata block stacks compactly, one row per line
over: blank lines between every row including metadata
because: metadata rows are one identity read as a unit; the body fields are separate claims (chose/over/because) that earn block spacing — and an airy metadata block would push the body below the fold on short terminals
